item.description:
Menu bar overhaul: Preferences (⌘,), quick access to New Connection/History/Stats/Gallery, New Tab, Move/Copy selection in Edit.
New About panel with credits + GitHub link.
Real auto-updates via Sparkle (Check for Updates…).
Help menu: Report an Issue (GitHub) and Send Feedback (email).
New Stats window: bucket size, oldest/largest file, file types, estimated B2 cost, upload activity.
